_help: Act 6: the race back to Cairo. Every day travelled ticks the thieves and mummy countdowns.
title: The race back to Cairo
intro: The thieves are ahead. The mummy is behind.

options.label: Across the desert
options.desc: The fastest way back, if there are enough horses for everyone. Without them, the mummy catches you in the open.

options.label: Along the coast
options.desc: Slower, but the trucks and any animals the other expeditions spare can carry everyone. The mummy gains on Cairo every extra day.

options.label: The river
options.desc: There are no riverboats left for your expedition.
